title: Highly Skilled Professional (i) - Category Ro
docsTitle: Highly Skilled Professional Type 1 Visa  Required Documents
tips:
- A minimum of 70 points based on education, work experience, annual income, age, etc. is required.

- If you graduated from a Japanese university, JLPT N2 does not count for extra points.

- If you claim points for work experience, it must match the job duties you are applying for. Where possible, ask your 'Certificate of Employment' or 'Certificate of Separation' to include specific job duties.

> 📊 Use the points calculator

> 🔗 [Highly Skilled Professional Points Calculator](/ja/tools/hsp-points)
> 
> ⚠️ Important: The points calculation sheet is a required document at the time of application.
